<DESCRIPTION>AUTHORIZATION TO EXERCISE OPTION TO REPURCHASE AND CONSENT, DATED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026, BY COMMODITY CAPITAL ADVISORS LLC, ABSTRACT CONCEPTS 1618 LLC, AND MINERALRITE CORPORATION.
<TEXT>
<HTML>
<HEAD>
<TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt; text-align: right"><B>Exhibit 10.3&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt; text-align: center"><B>AUTHORIZATION TO EXERCISE OPTION TO REPURCHASE
AND CONSENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">This Authorization to Exercise Option to Repurchase
and Consent (this &ldquo;Authorization&rdquo;) is entered into as of September 30, 2026 (the &ldquo;Closing Date&rdquo;) and shall be
effective on such date, by Commodity Capital Advisors LLC (&ldquo;Commodity&rdquo;), acting through its manager, Abstract Concepts 1618
LLC (&ldquo;Abstract&rdquo;), with the acknowledgment and consent of MineralRite Corporation, a Texas corporation (&ldquo;RITE&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>WHEREAS,</B> Commodity and RITE entered into that
certain Option to Repurchase Agreement effective October 7, 2025 (the &ldquo;Option Agreement&rdquo;), concerning the derivative, fixed,
terminating production payment royalty described therein (the &ldquo;Asset&rdquo;);</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>WHEREAS,</B> Abstract is the manager of Commodity
and originally provided the royalty interest constituting the Asset to RITE on behalf of Commodity in connection with Commodity&rsquo;s
investment in RITE;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>WHEREAS,</B> Commodity desires to exercise the
Option, with Abstract acting on Commodity&rsquo;s behalf and applying a portion of the RITE promissory note held by Abstract in payment
of Commodity&rsquo;s Accreted Repurchase Price; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>WHEREAS</B>, RITE acknowledges and consents to
the foregoing arrangement and agrees to accept such application of the RITE promissory note as payment on behalf of Commodity.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>1. Authorization and Exercise</B>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">Commodity, acting through Abstract as its manager,
hereby exercises the Option to repurchase the Asset pursuant to the Option Agreement and authorizes Abstract to take all actions reasonably
necessary to effect such exercise and repurchase on Commodity&rsquo;s behalf.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>2. Waiver of Notice; Payment.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">RITE acknowledges Commodity&rsquo;s exercise of the
Option, waives the ten-business-day exercise notice period solely for the Closing contemplated hereby, and agrees to accept $246,188 through
application of the RITE promissory note held by Abstract as full payment, on behalf of Commodity, of the Accreted Repurchase Price due
under the Option Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>3. Effect of Closing.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">Upon application of $246,188 of the RITE promissory
note held by Abstract, the Option shall be deemed fully exercised and the Accreted Repurchase Price fully paid. The Asset shall be transferred
by RITE to Commodity Capital Advisors LLC, free and clear of liens created by RITE, and Commodity shall thereafter have no further right
to repurchase the Asset under the Option Agreement.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>4. No Assignment.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">For the avoidance of doubt, the arrangements contemplated
hereby do not constitute an assignment by Commodity of the Option or the Asset to Abstract. Abstract is acting as manager of Commodity
and on Commodity&rsquo;s behalf in connection with the exercise of the Option and payment of the Accreted Repurchase Price.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><B>5. Miscellaneous.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">Except as expressly provided herein, the Option Agreement
remains unchanged. This Authorization is governed by Texas law and may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt; text-align: center"><I>[Signature Page to Follow]</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 6pt">&nbsp;</P>
